The saleable Scheduled energy for year 2014-15, 2015-16 and 2016-17 was more than the saleable design energy in the tariff period 2014-19 which clearly shows that Petitioner could not fulfill the mandatory condition of Proviso 44(7), i.e. there was no loss of energy for continuous period of 4 years. (ii) The Petitioner has earned energy charges on account of saleable scheduled energy more than the energy charges recoverable on account of saleable design energy during Tariff period 2014-19 (5 years), and therefore, Petitioner claim is liable to be dismissed.
